senses.gloss: वैवधिक वैवधिक, i. e. विवध + इक, m. A chandler, a vendor of grain, etc.

वैवर्ण्य वैवर्ण्य, i. e. वि-वर्ण + य, n.
 1. Change of colour, Pañc. i. d. 213.
 2. Deviation from tribe or caste.
 3. Difference.

वैवस्वत वैवस्वत, i. e. विवस्वन्त् + अ, patronym., m.
 1. Yama.
 2. The seventh Manu, Matsyop. 9 (cf. Man. 1, 62).
 3. One of the Rudras.
 4. The planet Saturn.

वैवाहिक वैवाहिक, i. e. विवाह + इक,
 I. adj. Relating to marriage, nuptial, Man. 2, 67.
 II. m. (or perhaps, तं तु is to be changed to तत् तु; then it would be n.), Wedding, Chr. 14, 21.
